steps.en: OCMS sends the defendants' IDs to the agencies
steps.id: OCMS mengirim ID defendant ke agency
steps.why_en: Warrant defendants are not part of the agency upload.
steps.why_id: Defendant warrant tidak ikut upload ke agency.

steps.en: OCMS stores the returned latest address
steps.id: OCMS menyimpan alamat terbaru hasil agency
steps.why_en: Only the general address update exists, not one for warrant defendants.
steps.why_id: Hanya update alamat umum, bukan untuk defendant warrant.

steps.en: Letter of Advice goes to the latest address
steps.id: Letter of Advice dikirim ke alamat terbaru
steps.why_en: No Letter of Advice exists to send.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada Letter of Advice yang bisa dikirim.
